Projects.Name: AutoVer
ChangelogMessages: Version Python projects: a pyproject.toml listed in autover.json is versioned through its [project] version (PEP 621), rewriting only that value so quoting, spacing, comments and line endings are kept as they were. A project without a version is seeded after its name, like the other project types

A pyproject.toml is never auto-discovered, because many repositories keep one purely for tool settings; discovering those would start versioning a lint config in repositories that rely on discovery today

Refused with an explanation rather than guessed at: a version listed in [project] dynamic (computed by the build backend), a [tool.poetry]-only project, a non-string version, and a version AutoVer cannot increment (a normalized spelling such as 1.2.3b1)

A prerelease label must be a Python pre-release (PEP 440): alpha, beta, rc (and their short forms), pre/preview or dev, optionally numbered. Anything else fails the release before any project file is written, rather than producing a package pip refuses to install (hotfix) or a post-release that pip installs ahead of the real version (post.1)

A version a pyproject.toml cannot take (not a valid Python version) now fails the release before any project file is written, so a repository mixing .csproj, Dockerfile and pyproject.toml projects is not left with the others bumped and staged

A project file that fails to load now reports why: the configuration-loading error includes the underlying cause (e.g. a missing project file, a pyproject.toml that cannot be versioned, or the JSON path of an invalid setting) instead of only naming autover.json
